main.title: About me
text: Third-year CS student who loves cross-platform development. I build apps with Flutter and React Native and I am looking for a summer internship where I can work on a production mobile app.

items.heading: Campus Map (Flutter)
bullets: Indoor map of the faculty buildings written in Dart with Flutter.
Used Google Maps SDK and a small REST API built with Firebase Functions.

items.heading: Habit Tracker (React Native, Expo)
bullets: Daily habit tracking app with local notifications and charts.
State management with Zustand; data stored in AsyncStorage.
